description: This file defines classes and functions for handling log messages, including formatted and unformatted log message classes, and a text formatting function. It is part of a logging or tracing system within a larger project.

classes.name: LogMessage
classes.description: Base class representing a log message with text, time, tag, level, at, and timestamp properties.

classes.name: FormattedLogMessage
classes.description: Subclass of LogMessage that formats a message with specific timestamp handling based on timestamp type and offset.

classes.name: UnformattedLogMessage
classes.description: Subclass of LogMessage that formats a message without specific formatting, using provided proto and message data.

methods.name: formatText
methods.description: Formats a message string with parameters, handling various format specifiers like %d, %s, %f, etc.

methods.name: getParam
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter from an array at a specified index, throws error if index is out of bounds.
